🇩🇪 A1 GERMAN VOCABULARY: Verkehr (Transport)

der Zug = train
das Fahrrad = bicycle
das Auto = car
das Taxi = taxi
die U-Bahn = subway
die Straßenbahn = tram

💡 Tip: Learn der/die/das with every noun.
